summary: Sign in at the portal URL with Sign In and your AAP credentials. The error 'Login failed; caused by Error: Failed to send POST request: fetch failed' means the portal can't verify AAP's SSL certificate; trust the custom CA rather than setting checkSSL: false.
questions: Login failed; caused by Error: Failed to send POST request: fetch failed
How do I sign in to self-service automation portal?
Portal login fails with self-signed certificate

answer_card.title: 'Failed to send POST request: fetch failed' at portal login
answer_card.answer_md:
The portal can't verify the SSL certificate of your AAP instance (custom or self-signed CA).

**Fix:** configure the portal to trust the CA (ConfigMap with the CA mounted at `/etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/`, then `helm upgrade`).

`checkSSL: false` also works but disables verification; not recommended for production.
